pairAdmissibilityNote: All pair figures are PRE-FILTER ESTIMATES computed from published artifact sizes (dims x bytes_per_value x 250000 x 2 + embedding_session_artifact_bytes + reranker_session_artifact_bytes). onnxSource.note: Official upstream publishes AVX-512-VNNI-only static int8; the mirror's portable dynamic-int8/f32 exports pinned to one immutable revision are used.

biEncoderCandidates.functionalRejection: 128-token context cannot honor the required transcript window profiles (256/48, 384/64, 512/96); measured only as a second-family diagnostic.

biEncoderCandidates.rejectedBeforeBenchmark: No ONNX export exists in the upstream repo and the model card carries no license field; unclear redistribution is a blocker, so this distinct family has no redistributable portable export (verified via HF API 2026-08-22).
1024-dim f32 storage is 2048000000 bytes at 250k x2; even int8 storage plus a >=1 GB session exceeds the band.
768-dim f32 storage fails outright and the ~501M-parameter f32 session (~1.9 GB) cannot fit any admissible pairing.

biEncoderCandidates.rejectedBeforeFullBenchmark: Both available exports (upstream quint8_avx2 and mirror dynamic-int8) output raw last_hidden_state without the required Dense(768->512)+normalize head, verified by probe (inputs [input_ids, attention_mask], outputs [last_hidden_state], dim 768). Mean-pooled hidden states are not distiluse embeddings, so faithful Rust preprocessing is impossible with redistributable portable exports.

embedding.pooling: masked-mean over attention_mask positions of last_hidden_state

tokenizer.truncationStrategy: LongestFirst across the encoded pair, preserving special tokens

embedding.sessionPrecision: dynamic int8 (measured vs f32 session: mean cosine agreement 0.9919, min 0.9871)
embedding.vectorEncoding: int8-storage (measured zero Evidence Recall@5 cost vs f32/fp16)
embedding.resourceNote: Measured peaks: the card-multilingual-conforming e5-small-int8+mmarco-quint8 pair is 966.8 MiB (automatic pass) but fails NDCG/quality gates; the quality-leading e5-small-int8+bge-reranker-base-int8 pair is metadata-non-conforming and measures 1116.7 MiB (approval band).

candidatesBenchmarked: BAAI/bge-reranker-base via Xenova/bge-reranker-base @280bcc27 int8 export (card multilingual NON-conforming)
BAAI/bge-reranker-base fp16 export (budget-excluded under deterministic policy)
reranker.leaderRationale: BAAI/bge-reranker-base via Xenova/bge-reranker-base @280bcc27a84e0b898c251e06fddb25171bd9b101 int8 export - highest deterministic NDCG among budget-viable candidates, BUT metadata non-conforming (card zh/en); the metadata-conforming mmarco candidate degrades corpus NDCG. Reranker choice therefore also requires the user/architecture decision recorded in measuredOutcome.decision.
reranker.pairFormat: tokenizer pair encoding <s>query</s></s>evidence</s> with LongestFirst truncation across the pair at maxSequenceLength preserving the question and separators

chunkPolicy.selection: 384/64 default window; all three profiles produced identical chunk sets and metrics on the synthetic corpus, so profile choice is cost-driven; sections are separate chunks (merging measurably corrupts reranker scoring); latest-summary-only equals all-labeled-summary-templates because fixtures carry one latest-template summary per meeting

referenceExpectations.note: Platform-neutral reference values recorded from actual staged-artifact inference on the Windows x64 reference machine (Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX): e5-small dynamic-int8 session for embeddings; bge-reranker-base int8; mmarco-mMiniLMv2-L12-H384-v1 quint8_avx2 and f32. Replays must use the identical batch composition per group because dynamic-int8 activation scales depend on padded batch width.

measuredOutcome.notes: Pair peaks measured in isolated fresh processes with both sessions simultaneously resident plus post-inference RSS delta, plus 192 MiB int8 vectors at 250k (command in report §4). The card-conforming pair passes RAM automatically but fails NDCG/quality gates (its tuned gamma is 0: reranking degrades its corpus NDCG). The quality-leading non-conforming pair reaches reference rank 2 with complete facts at gamma 8 but remains outside rank 1/contamination-free and would separately need risk approval for 1116.7 MiB.
